model.title: Endless Mountains National Heritage Area Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. David McCormick (R-PA)

summary.text: The bill would designate a region in Pennsylvania called the Endless Mountains as a National Heritage Area, integrating it into the federal National Heritage Area System. This would provide a framework for preserving and promoting the area's natural, cultural, and historical resources while supporting economic development and community engagement in the region.
